$description: Grow Assist tokens. Format module 2025.10. Semantic colors in this file are the dark theme, which is the only theme the stylesheet ships. Light overrides live in grow_assist.light.tokens.json. The resolver default is dark.

primitive.$description: Generic scales. Names are not domain terms.

white.$description: Button label. The stylesheet writes the keyword white.

black.$description: Shadow ink. The stylesheet writes rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3).

50.$description: Light theme page canvas. Not in the current stylesheet.

100.$description: Dark theme text. CSS custom property --text-primary.

200.$description: Draft dark secondary text. CSS --text-secondary is #cbd5e1, which is Lc -70.5 on the recommendation surface.

300.$description: CSS --text-secondary. Recorded. Semantic text uses slate.200 so recommendation copy clears APCA Lc 75.

400.$description: CSS --text-muted and, in this draft, the dark border.

500.$description: Light theme border. Not in the current stylesheet.

600.$description: Light theme muted text. Not in the current stylesheet.

100.$description: CSS --primary-light. Defined on :root and read by no rule. Used here as the light summary wash.

200.$description: Draft dark summary heading. #6ee7b7 on the summary surface is Lc -73.8.

300.$description: Draft dark-theme green text. Replaces #10b981 where that green is body text.

600.$description: CSS --primary-hover. Recorded from the stylesheet. Semantic tokens do not reference it.

700.$description: Light theme analyze fill. White on this green is 5.48:1.

950.$description: Dark theme analyze label. Dark text on #6ee7b7.

300.$description: Recorded so a large-text violet can clear WCAG. The stylesheet uses #8b5cf6.

500.$description: CSS --secondary. Used by the header gradient. No semantic token references it.

200.$description: Draft dark problem text and high-priority badge text.

300.$description: CSS problem text and high badge text. Draft high-priority edge. #f87171 on #334155 is Lc -39.

400.$description: Recorded candidate for the high edge. #ef4444 on #334155 is 2.75:1. #f87171 is Lc -39, so the edge uses red.300.

500.$description: CSS high-priority edge. 2.75:1 on #334155. Not referenced.
CSS priority-medium accent. Kept. It clears 3:1 on #334155.

700.$description: Draft light medium-priority accent. #d97706 on #f1f5f9 is 2.91:1.

300.$description: CSS low badge text. Draft low-priority edge. #60a5fa on #334155 is Lc -42.

400.$description: Recorded candidate. Lc -42 on #334155, so the edge uses blue.300.

500.$description: CSS low-priority edge. 2.82:1 on #334155. Not referenced.

badgeHigh.$description: Draft dark high-priority badge surface. Replaces a 20% red wash.

summary.$description: Draft dark summary surface. Replaces the green-to-violet gradient wash.

muted.$description: Draft dark muted text. #94a3b8 on #334155 is 4.04:1. This step clears 4.5:1 on canvas, surface, and raised.

1.$description: 4px. The 0.25rem gaps in stage details and product details.

2.$description: 8px. Also the merged badge padding. CSS badge padding-block is 0.35rem, the only off-scale space.

4.$description: 16px. The most used space in the stylesheet.

space.$description: 4px steps, stored in rem so they follow the root font size. space.4 is 1rem.

12.$description: 12px at a 16px root. Priority badge only.

20.$description: 20px. Merges 1.2rem. Also the compact section title, which is already 1.25rem.

32.$description: 32px compact page title and the product emoji.

40.$description: 40px. One-off. The stacked layout title between the 32px phone title and the 48px desktop title.

48.$description: 48px desktop page title and the stage emoji.

regular.$description: User-agent initial. The stylesheet never sets 400. Body text inherits it.

prose.$description: Merged from 1.7 on the summary and recommendation, and 1.8 on .ai-message. That class is not in the shell.

2.$description: Fields, analyze button, product link, response container.

3.$description: CSS --radius. Also merges the 10px product block.

full.$description: Merged from the 20px badge radius so a wrapping badge stays a pill.

field.$description: Fields, stage, recommendation, and product link borders.

rest.$description: Offset of the analyze button and the product link, CSS 0 4px 12px. The stylesheet tints that shadow green. This draft uses 30% black, the same ink as the section shadow.

hover.$description: One hover shadow. The button hover is 0 6px 20px at 40% green, the card hover is 0 8px 20px at 30% black, and the stage hover is 0 8px 20px at 20% green.

productMin.$description: One-off. Product row min-width before it wraps.

lift.$description: Hover lift for the button, product link, and recommendation.

liftStage.$description: One-off. Stage cards lift 4px. They are the selection target, so the lift stays larger than the button.

compact.$description: One-off. Phone padding, stacked stage cards, and the compact type step.

stack.$description: One-off. The width where the form and the recommendations stop sitting side by side. Not merged with 640px or with 1024px.

semantic.$description: Names from the Gleam modules. shell, focus, and apiKey are proposals. See design/tokens/README.md.

shell.$description: Proposal. shell.gleam is the view module. There is no Shell type. Confirm the name with NJ before code agents use it.

textSecondary.$description: Secondary text. Shifted from #cbd5e1 so recommendation descriptions clear APCA Lc 75 on the raised surface.

muted.$description: Footer text. Shifted from #94a3b8 so it clears 4.5:1 on raised as well as on canvas.

border.$description: Borders. CSS #334155 fails 3:1. #94a3b8 passes WCAG and is Lc -42 on raised, under the APCA UI bar of 45, so the border uses the muted ink. The border and the footer are the same ink, so a border can read as strongly as footer text.

status.$description: shell.Status: Waiting, Loading, Problem, Ready. Ready has no color of its own. It uses summary and recommendation.

waiting.$description: Waiting placeholder. CSS uses --text-muted. Secondary text is Lc -79 on the canvas. Muted is about Lc -60.

problem.$description: Problem text. CSS #fca5a5 passes WCAG and is about Lc -65. #fecaca is the draft for body-size error text.

badgeSurface.$description: High priority badge surface. CSS is rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2) over #334155.

stage.$description: shell.Stage: Seedling, Vegetation, Flowering. The three stages share one color. The stylesheet does not color them differently.

vpd.$description: VPD line on a stage card. VPD is prompt language, not a Gleam type. CSS --primary as text is Lc -52 at 0.85rem.

selected.$description: Selected stage border. CSS --primary. 7.04:1 on the canvas.

heading.$description: Summary heading. Lighter than the VPD line because the summary surface is lighter than the canvas.

surface.$description: Summary surface. CSS is a 135deg gradient of 10% green and 10% violet over the canvas.

accent.$description: Product block border. CSS --primary. Passes 3:1 on the canvas.

action.$description: View product fill. The stylesheet uses the same gradient as Analyze.

fill.$description: Dark analyze fill. A #047857 fill on the #1e293b section is 2.67:1, so the dark theme uses the light green and dark label instead of white on green.

focus.$description: Proposal. No domain term for the keyboard focus indicator. This is the CSS focus border color, which already passes 3:1. The 10% ring does not.
Solid 3px focus ring in the dark theme.

display.$description: Page title at the desktop size. The h1 does not set its own line height.

displayStacked.$description: Page title when the columns stack, under 968px.

body.$description: Body, fields, and the analyze label size.

small.$description: Footer, VPD line, API key hint, stage temperature and humidity.

badge.$description: Priority badge. The 0.75rem size stays because it is uppercase. Tracking stays 0.5px.

analyze.$description: Analyze and the product link label.

component.$description: Grower-facing parts. Each value aliases a semantic or primitive token.

shell.$description: Proposal. Page chrome. Confirm shell with NJ.

detail.$description: Temperature and humidity. CSS uses --text-muted. Those numbers are part of the job.

readings.$description: Model.readings. Readings is a field, not a type.

apiKey.$description: Proposal. Model.api_key is a field. There is no ApiKey type. The field stays on the path until the hosted agent ships, then moves to an advanced option.

hint.$description: The hint under the field. Muted text is about Lc -60 here, under the APCA body bar.
